Our philosophy

We believe the best outfit starts with being heard.

We don't believe in one-size-fits-all style. We believe in the woman, her personality, her confidence and the details that make a piece unmistakably hers.

Our Hyderabad-led concept pairs personal consultations with thoughtfully coordinated tailoring and craftsmanship.

Good to know

Your questions, answered.

What should I bring to my appointment?

Bring any fabric, inspiration images or garments you'd like us to work with. An idea is enough to begin.

Can I discuss bridal or special-occasion outfits?

Yes. Select the bridal or occasionwear service when requesting your consultation.

Will I get a WhatsApp confirmation?

For this prototype, you can prepare a WhatsApp appointment message. Automatic confirmations require the live WhatsApp Business integration.

Darzaan | Information practices

Privacy notice

We collect your name, mobile number, service preferences, requested appointment date and time, and any optional details you provide. We use this information to respond to your appointment or franchise enquiry and provide requested customer service. We may use an authorized messaging provider to send appointment-related WhatsApp notifications if configured.

We do not collect online payments through this site. We restrict employee access to enquiry records, and we do not sell customer information to advertisers.

To request access, correction or deletion, contact Darzaan using the contact details supplied by the team. The operator must publish verified legal entity details, a designated privacy contact, retention periods and required statutory disclosures before public launch.
